newsitem.title: USA: May & Speh names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: May & Speh names chief financial officer.

text.p: May & Speh Inc said Monday it named Eric Loughmiller as executive vice president and chief financial officer.
Loughmiller replaces Robert Early, who moves into the position of executive vice president, corporate development.
Loughmiller joins May & Speh from the Chicago office of Price Waterhouse LLP, where he was a partner in the firm's audit practice.

"The addition of Eric Loughmiller to our management team will allow Robert Early to re-focus his efforts on corporate growth initiatives," Lawrence Speh, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
May & Speh provides integrated data management services.
